title: Algorithm for finding vertex-edge domination number on graphs with bounded treewidth and related problems on planar graphs
summary: Given a graph $G=(V,E)$, a vertex $u \in V$ {\em ve-dominates} all edges incident to any vertex of $N_G[u]$. A set $S \subseteq V$ is a {\em ve-dominating set} if for all edges $e\in E$, there exists a vertex $u\in S$ such that $u$ ve-dominates $e$. The minimum cardinality among all ve-dominating sets is known as the \textit{vertex-edge domination number} (or simply ve-domination number) and denoted by $γ_{ve}(G)$.
